sections.text: Wisdom Oracle is a progressive web app that brings together two timeless sources of wisdom:
sections.list: Bhagavad Gītā As It Is — 1972 Unabridged Edition (Macmillan) I Ching the Book of Changes — Richard Wilhelm translation

Fully offline — once cached, works without internet. Perfect for airplane mode. Auto-updates — service worker fetches improvements in the background. Share or Copy any verse or hexagram directly from the card view. Installable — add to home screen and open like a native app. Privacy focused — No ads, and zero distractions.

Developer: WebKide Library: html2canvas.min.js — shareable PNG cards Data: JSON files stored locally, no external requests Repository: GitHub/WebKide/gitawisdom Live URL: https://webkide.github.io/gitawisdom
sections.text: <hr>Official launch date: 24.06.2026 on the celebration of the appearance of Gaṅgāmātā Gosvāminī and the disappearance of Śrīla Baladeva Vidyābhūṣaṇa, the festival of Gaṅgā-daśaharā and Śrī Gaṅgā pūjā.
